_comment_ref: MUST be the UCSC chr-named hg38.fa: the vg-giraffe BAM is chr-named, and this single ref drives samtools-sort/markdup + DeepVariant + ExpansionHunter + bcftools-norm. Do NOT use the Ensembl-numeric fastafile here (contig-name mismatch); VEP keeps its own numeric vep_fasta_file below.
_comment_eh_variant_catalog: Optional. Defaults to Illumina's GRCh38 catalog baked into the dunglam2k/expansionhunter-grch38:v5.0.0 image. To override, add an 'eh_variant_catalog' File entry pointing at a custom catalog in Keep.
_comment_slivar: slivar_info / slivar_sample_expr intentionally omitted: the strengthened rarity+quality gate now lives as the validated default in main-vg.cwl. Do not re-add a stale override here (an old permissive override was the reason a required setting drifted out of sync).
_comment_patient_context: Patient sex and HPO terms are derived at run time from the Genoor metadata file above. Included phenotype URIs should identify HPO terms (for example http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0000726), and patient.gender must be male or female. For a legacy Genoor record whose phenotype URIs are null, supply the curated comma-separated list as the optional hpo_terms input; coded metadata always takes precedence.
_comment_exomiser: Exomiser phenotype-driven prioritisation. exomiser_data is the 2512 hg38+phenotype bundle Keep collection (required).
